info.title: Troziana Enterprise Travel & Umrah ERP API
info.description: Complete Production REST API Contract for Troziana Multi-Branch Travel & Umrah ERP. Synchronized 1-to-1 with the Express.js + TypeScript + MongoDB backend.

BearerAuth.description: Pass `Bearer <access_token>` for standard routes, or `Refresh <refresh_token>` (or `Bearer <refresh_token>`) on `/api/v1/auth/refresh-token`.

CookieAuth.name: access_token
CookieAuth.description: HttpOnly `access_token` and `refresh_token` cookies set automatically by `/api/v1/auth/login` and `/api/v1/auth/refresh-token`.

ValidationError.description: Validation Error (Zod schema validation or invalid input)

UnauthorizedError.description: Authentication Error (Missing, expired, or revoked JWT / session)

ForbiddenError.description: Authorization Error (Missing RBAC permission or unauthorized cross-branch access)

example.message: Cross-branch access denied for the requested branch scope

NotFoundError.description: Resource Not Found (or hidden due to branch-scope isolation)

ConflictError.description: Conflict Error (Duplicate unique key, seat overbooking race, or concurrent write conflict)

example.message: No available seats remaining in trip shared inventory

UnprocessableDomainError.description: Domain Rule Violation (Insufficient cashbox balance, unbalanced journal entry, or illegal booking state transition)

example.message: Unbalanced journal entry rejected: Total Debits (5000) !== Total Credits (4500)

isCentralAdmin.description: True if user holds a central role or canAccessAllBranches

get.description: Verify API service status and documentation link

example.message: Troziana Enterprise Travel ERP API is running

post.summary: 1. Login (Issues Access & Refresh Tokens + HttpOnly Cookies)
post.description: Authenticate with email and password; returns JWT tokens, RBAC roles/permissions, and sets HttpOnly cookies

get.summary: 2. Get Current User & Effective RBAC/Branch Context (/me)

post.description: Rotates the refresh token and issues a new access_token + refresh_token pair. Pass refresh_token in Authorization header or cookie.

get.description: Lists all active refresh-token sessions for the current user across devices

post.description: Revokes current token/session (action=0) or all user sessions (action=1) and clears HttpOnly cookies
